projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Add undeclared attributes to PipelineState dataclass

Add entity_videos field (type Dict[str, Any], default empty dict) to PipelineState since entity_videos.py and output.py write/read it without declaration

Verify all stage files in src/stages/ that access these attributes no longer risk AttributeError
Run existing tests to confirm no regressions from adding new dataclass fields
userStories.notes: Added entity_images (Dict[str, Any], default {}), entity_videos (Dict[str, Any], default {}), voiceover_embeddings (Optional[Any], default None) to PipelineState in src/state.py. userStories.title: Guard against cascading confidence penalties in scoring
acceptanceCriteria: Add minimum confidence floor (e.g., 0.05) in src/matching/scoring.py to prevent cascading multiplicative penalties from reducing confidence to near-zero
Add mutual exclusivity check or clear precedence for caption_quality multiplicative mode (lines 287-298) vs additive mode (lines 303-316) to prevent both running on same match
Add logging when confidence drops below 0.15 after penalty application to flag over-penalized matches
Add test case in tests/test_matching_scoring.py for cascading penalties scenario: caption quality 0.9 multiplier + timing penalty 0.6 should not reduce 0.8 confidence below floor
Add test case verifying only one caption quality mode (multiplicative OR additive) applies per match
userStories.notes: Added CONFIDENCE_FLOOR=0.05 in MatchScoring.apply_all_adjustments, mutual exclusivity for caption quality modes (multiplicative takes precedence), warning logging when confidence drops below 0.15, and 8 new test cases covering cascading penalties and mode exclusivity. 176 related tests pass.

userStories.title: Validate multimodal scoring weights sum and bounds
acceptanceCriteria: Add validation in src/matching/tiered_matcher.py around line 365 that multimodal_weights values are in [0.0, 1.0] range
Add validation that multimodal_weights sum to approximately 1.0 (within 0.01 tolerance) and log warning if not
If weights are invalid, normalize them to sum to 1.0 and log the correction rather than silently using bad values
Add test in tests/test_tiered_matcher_coverage.py verifying weights validation catches out-of-range values
Add test verifying weights normalization produces correct scores when sum != 1.0
userStories.notes: Added validate_multimodal_weights() in scoring.py that clamps individual weights to [0.0, 1.0], normalizes sum to 1.0 (0.01 tolerance), logs warnings for corrections, falls back to defaults for all-zero. Called from tiered_matcher.py line 365 and compute_multimodal_score. 5 new tests in test_tiered_matcher_coverage.py. 86 scoring/multimodal tests pass, 0 regressions.

userStories.title: Ensure confidence_variance and matched_keywords propagate on all MatchResult paths
acceptanceCriteria: Audit all code paths in src/matching/tiered_matcher.py that create MatchResult objects and verify confidence_variance is always set (lines 713, 794, 966 and any others)
Audit all code paths that create MatchResult and verify matched_keywords is always populated (not left as None or empty when keywords exist)
Add default values for confidence_variance (0.0) and matched_keywords (empty list) in MatchResult constructor or dataclass definition if they can be omitted
Remove defensive getattr(r, 'confidence_variance', 0.0) in src/matching/main.py:601 after ensuring field is always present
Add test verifying MatchResult objects from all 7 matching strategies contain both confidence_variance and matched_keywords fields
userStories.notes: Audited all 5 MatchResult creation paths in tiered_matcher.py and 1 in output.py. Dataclass defaults already guarantee both fields. Removed 4 defensive getattr() calls in main.py (lines 579, 601, 617) and stages/match.py (lines 172, 174), replacing with direct field access. Added 13 tests in test_matchresult_field_propagation.py covering dataclass defaults, gap paths, explicit paths, direct access patterns, and TieredMatcher integration. 284 related tests pass.

userStories.title: Add unit tests for alternative_selection module
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/test_matching_alternative_selection.py with tests for the alternative selection logic in src/matching/alternative_selection.py
Test that V2-V3 alternatives are selected with confidence above a minimum threshold
Test that V4-V6 secondary matches use diversity scoring and differ from primary selections
Test edge case where candidate pool has fewer videos than requested alternatives
Test that alternatives do not duplicate the primary match for any segment
userStories.notes: 30 tests in tests/test_matching_alternative_selection.py covering: config defaults, constructor paths, V2-V3 alternatives (source exclusion, confidence retention, fallback penalty, diversity preference, empty/small pools, scene callbacks), V4-V6 secondary matches (3-pass selection, source exclusion, confidence penalties per pass, segment deduplication, reasoning labels, alt_segments exclusion). All 30 pass.

userStories.title: Add unit tests for similarity_cache thread safety and eviction
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/test_matching_similarity_cache.py with tests for src/matching/similarity_cache.py
Test that cache returns consistent results for identical embedding pairs
Test cache eviction when max_size is reached (entries are evicted, not growing unbounded)
Test concurrent access from multiple threads does not corrupt cache state or raise exceptions

userStories.title: Add unit tests for iterative_match gap_analyzer module
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/test_iterative_match_gap_analyzer.py with tests for src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py
Test gap detection identifies segments with confidence below threshold
Test gap detection identifies segments with no match at all (None or empty)
Test gap analysis with all segments above threshold returns no gaps
Test gap analysis with mixed confidence levels correctly ranks gaps by severity
Test edge case with empty segment list returns empty gap list
userStories.notes: 56 tests passing. Covers GapSegment/GapAnalysis dataclasses, _classify_gap_pattern (all 6 pattern types + priority order), _has_location_pattern, _has_proper_noun, analyze_gaps (empty, single, mixed, entities, clustered), extract_keywords_for_gap (all pattern types, dedup, limits), LockedMatch, word list sanity checks.

userStories.title: Expand scoring test coverage for adaptive threshold edge cases
acceptanceCriteria: Add test in tests/test_matching_scoring.py for adaptive threshold with empty voiceover text (0 chars) - verify threshold adjusts appropriately
Add test for adaptive threshold with very large candidate pool (1000+ candidates) to verify normalization behavior
Add test for adaptive threshold with very small candidate pool (1-2 candidates) to verify it does not produce unreasonable thresholds
Add test for candidate variance exactly at 0.05 boundary to verify threshold boost is applied correctly
Add test verifying pool normalization reference size (50 candidates) produces expected scaling for pools of 10, 50, and 200
userStories.notes: 9 tests added in TestAdaptiveThresholdEdgeCases class. Empty/None voiceover (0 chars) triggers short_vo. Large pool 1000/2000 capped at max factor 1.2 (same result). Small pool 1-2 candidates boosts within bounds. Variance at 0.05 boundary: exact 0.05 does NOT trigger, below 0.05 DOES. Pool scaling 10/50/200: small boosts > reference unchanged > large reduces. All 45 tests pass.

Add source concentration pattern: detect when multiple low-confidence segments all rely on the same source video, suggesting the video pool is too narrow
Add confidence variance pattern entry at lines 599-602 where variance is checked but no pattern object is created
Add test in tests/test_matching_main_extended.py verifying new patterns appear in analysis results for matching scenarios with empty keywords and concentrated sources
userStories.notes: Added source_concentration pattern to analyze_low_confidence_segments (3+ low-conf segments from same source). Verified existing patterns: missing_keywords, no_keyword_overlap, high_variance already implemented. Added 8 tests in TestLowConfidenceAnalysisPatterns class in test_matching_main_extended.py.
